[{"id": "jZoreGPgH6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\ude4fPrayers Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vrycYCfMcK", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Prayers module collects the prayer requests of your church and the prayers that people offer for them. Members share requests in the member portal, guests send them from the website, and staff add them in the desk. Each request says who may read it, from the pastors only to the whole church.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "F8UmrRTVyN", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church Pastoral Care and Church Manager users look after the requests: they read every request, approve requests for the prayer list and set the status. The prayer team reads and prays for the requests in the member portal. Other staff see only the requests that they made themselves.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "O6BwQiCH1F", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Prayers workspace starts with the requests that wait for you: Urgent Prayer Requests, Awaiting Approval and Ending This Week (the open requests whose End Date is in the next 7 days). Under them, a chart shows the active requests by type. The sidebar lists Prayer Requests, Awaiting Approval and Prayers.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "thcmYHAbqE", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Reports folder holds the Active Prayer List, Urgent Prayer Requests, Ending This Week, Recently Created and Recently Answered. Request Statuses and Request Types are in the Setup folder. The Summary workspace also shows the Active Prayer Requests and Prayers Answered This Month cards.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "PzrE3zb3gc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\ude47Prayer Request", "col": 12}}, {"id": "uVsy3NH6dV", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Prayer Request is one need that someone asks the church to pray for. It holds the request text, the person or thing it is for, who may read it, and its status, from Requested to Answered.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "bzdK9MJX7j", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "", "col": 12}}, {"id": "zanxm-oRGo", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
Anna asks the church to pray for her mother's surgery. She opens My Prayer Requests in the member portal, writes the request, picks her mother in Prayer For and chooses Prayer Team. The pastors and the prayer team get an email, and the prayer team sees the request on the Prayer List in the member portal. Three weeks later the surgery went well, and the pastor sets the status to Answered.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "4N15ewFy0h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Where requests come from", "col": 12}}, {"id": "67ZfoP_Oqw", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The desk: staff open Prayer Requests and click Add Prayer Request.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3FJLTcFsKb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The member portal: a member opens My Prayer Requests and shares a request. The page lists the member's own requests with their status, who can see them, who they are for and how many times people prayed for them.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "5KaBD-cFZS", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- The website: a guest who is not signed in fills in the anonymous form at /prayer-request-anonymous/new. The Ask for prayer links on the website open it. After a guest sends it, the page says that staff read each request before it goes on the prayer list. A request from a guest always waits for approval (see below).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "YrSgdK8JMO", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Fill in a request", "col": 12}}, {"id": "jzo7jcP7Xq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Title: a few words, such as Surgery for my mother.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "DQRYfa92IJ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Type: the kind of request. You can add types under Request Types. The Request text is optional for the types Unspoken and Salvation and required for every other type.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "JM7MyehK34", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Prayer For: the person that the request is for. Leave it blank for a general request, such as peace in the church. To pray for another kind of record, such as a Missionary, a Family or a Group, change Prayer For Type first.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "rCHuWWAiud", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Visibility: who may read the request (see below). A new request is Private until you choose.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "wiPvB0Rwsr", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Urgent: tick it for a need that cannot wait (see below).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "e9brV6y7SX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- End Date (in the Listing and Expiry section): the last date and time that the request stays on the prayer lists. Leave it blank to keep the request until its status changes.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "hkxiaAuLLi", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Who can read a request", "col": 12}}, {"id": "gvZQXWv1PU", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Visibility field decides who may read a request:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "GFn5wnJCIb", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Private: only the person who made it and the pastoral care team (Church Pastoral Care, Church Manager and System Manager users).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "uM0w5DfXFh", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Prayer Team: also the prayer team. The Prayer List in the member portal marks these requests Prayer team only, to ask the team to keep them within the team.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "MShI2TtxgV", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Whole Church: also every member, on the Prayer List in the member portal. Only these requests can go in a bulletin.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "wcBmTv4aLd", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Approve a request for the prayer list", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TabwCCaVWr", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Visibility says who may read a request. Approved for List says whether the request is ready to show. A request shows on the Prayer List and in bulletins only when both allow it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "lFynXke-Kp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A request that staff or a member adds is approved at once. A request from a guest on the website is not, because anyone can type anything into a public form. It shows to nobody but the pastoral care team until someone approves it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "FHn2GnFk_k", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Click Awaiting Approval in the sidebar or on the workspace. It lists the requests that are not approved, not Private and not closed, the oldest first.
2. Open a request and read it.
3. Tick Approved for List in the Listing and Expiry section and save.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "0wET8lcV5h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To approve many requests at one time, select them in the list, click Edit, set Approved for List and click Update. Only Church Manager, Church Pastoral Care and System Manager users can change this box.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "nxAm7z3JGv", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
On Monday morning the church secretary opens Awaiting Approval and finds four requests that guests sent over the weekend. Three are real needs, so she approves them. The fourth is an advertisement, so she deletes it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "HKVBC6mfYa", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Status and End Date", "col": 12}}, {"id": "HmzKyxv0M6", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A new request starts as Requested. The other statuses are Being Prayed For and Answered. Only Church Manager, Church Pastoral Care and System Manager users can change the status. Members, the prayer team and other staff can see it but not change it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "9jd6NaRpQg", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When the status changes to Answered, Churchit fills in Answered On with that day. The Prayers Answered This Month card and the reports of answered prayers count by this date. If you move the request away from Answered, Answered On is cleared.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Jm7UFN4N-R", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "You can add statuses under Request Statuses. A request leaves the prayer lists when its status is Answered, or a status named exactly Archived or Closed. A status with any other name keeps the request open.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "O6ntkFeLT5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The End Date takes a request off the prayer lists without a change of status. After that time, the request no longer shows on the Prayer List or in new bulletins. It still shows in the desk lists until you set its status.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "z-rMPClvGc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "After a request is Answered, Archived, Closed, not approved or past its End Date, members other than the person who asked cannot open it or pray for it, also from a link in an old email.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "NTPaxUFVPp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Example
A student asks for prayer during exam week and sets the End Date to Friday at 11:59 PM. After that time the request leaves the Prayer List by itself. It still counts in the Active Prayer Requests list in the desk until the pastor sets it to Answered.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "flksVof-mg", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "This is why the Active Prayer Requests card on the Summary can show a smaller number than the Active Prayer Requests list. The card counts only the open requests whose End Date has not passed. The list also shows open requests whose End Date has passed, so that you can find them and set their status.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3tgQJ5atd_", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Urgent requests", "col": 12}}, {"id": "qBtNiu4YVl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "An urgent request shows first on the Prayer List and in the bulletin, and its email subject starts with Urgent. It is listed under Urgent Prayer Requests until its status is Answered, Archived or Closed. An open urgent request also puts the person it is for (or the person who asked, for a general request) on the Pastoral Care Watch List (see the People manual).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OOTFvQ9n9S", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Who hears of a new request", "col": 12}}, {"id": "jiOsAYQENa", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When someone adds a prayer request, Churchit sends an email and a desk notification:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "aFbU7f-0Wd", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- A request that is not Private goes to the Church Pastoral Care and Church Manager users of its church, and to the prayer team when it is approved for the list.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vLkZxpEsTO", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- A request from a guest goes to the prayer team only after you approve it. The prayer team then gets one email about it.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "2oelwigQaG", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- A Private request goes only to Church Pastoral Care and Church Managers, and the email does not show what the request says.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "kxxeKpqclt", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Churchit sends the emails only when your site has an outgoing email account. Without one, people get only the desk notification. To change who gets these emails or what they say, a System Manager opens Notification and edits New Prayer Request for the Prayer Team, Approved Prayer Request for the Prayer Team or New Private Prayer Request.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "QOlBBJ4kCu", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The prayer team", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Gsh7NyKMJn", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To add someone to the prayer team, open their user and give it the Church Prayer Team role. A member of the prayer team sees the Prayer Team and Whole Church requests on the Prayer List in the member portal, and can pray for them. The prayer team never sees the Private requests of other people. A staff user with this role also sees these requests in the desk.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "WP1YYHDp0l", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Prayer List in the member portal", "col": 12}}, {"id": "oGVoVXxrIG", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Members read the requests that they may see on the Prayer List page of the member portal. Urgent requests are at the top. The home page of the member portal shows two of them under Remember in prayer.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "58TxG54YTR", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- I prayed: a member taps it after praying for a request. The button then shows You prayed for the rest of the day. On the request's own page, the member can add a short note with the prayer.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3_wymmDHvk", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Comments: a member can write a comment on a request that they can read. Everyone who can read the request sees the comment at once. A comment cannot hold a link or an email address.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "d3Qd0qZegi", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The member who made a request can change it or delete it on My Prayer Requests. After someone has prayed for it, it can no longer be deleted: the member can make it Private to take it off the list. Members cannot change the status, the approval or the End Date.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "dJAlbzJ60s", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The prayed count", "col": 12}}, {"id": "cFR2R9qL5-", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each request shows how many times people prayed for it, in the Prayed field and on the Prayer List. Each tap on I prayed adds one, and so does each Prayer record that names the request. A Prayer that lists the same request twice counts once. If you delete a Prayer, or move it to another request, the count changes. The count is of prayers, not of people: Anna praying on Monday and on Tuesday adds two.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "BqiQuVYRgk", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Print a prayer list", "col": 12}}, {"id": "sKBMfDrHi5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Active Prayer List report shows the open requests with their text and who may see them, urgent first. It leaves out requests whose End Date has passed. Without a filter, it shows the Whole Church and Prayer Team requests. To see the Private requests, choose Private in the Shared With filter. Click Print to give a copy to the prayer team.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Mpam8ImvcO", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Active Prayer List does not check Approved for List. Approve or leave out the requests in Awaiting Approval before you hand out a printed list.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "RqEsvILtpp", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To print one request, open it, click Print and choose the Prayer List print format.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6CrXWJyWAi", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayer requests in the bulletin", "col": 12}}, {"id": "EureGE664P", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A new Bulletin fills its prayer requests with the open, approved Whole Church requests of its church, urgent first. A bulletin refuses a request that is not Whole Church or not approved. The printed bulletin shows only the title and the name of the person each request is for, never the request text.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "gkxjy_knMf", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Reports", "col": 12}}, {"id": "JjdgOlZdW-", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "- Urgent Prayer Requests: the open urgent requests, also the ones past their End Date.
- Ending This Week: the open requests whose End Date is in the next 7 days.
- Recently Created: every request made since a date, whatever its status or visibility.
- Recently Answered: the requests answered since a date, the latest first.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "OnivhHy3w1", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "AI suggestions on new requests", "col": 12}}, {"id": "WhKdUa0tF_", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When AI is turned on (see the Foundations manual) and a Church Manager has turned on suggestions on new requests, Churchit asks an AI model about each new request that is not Private.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "3r2G39Q3Gd", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church Pastoral Care, Church Manager and System Manager users see the result in the AI Suggestion part at the top of the request: a suggested type, whether it seems urgent, flags such as Possible risk of harm or Health details, and a wording without names, health or contact details. In the AI Suggestion menu, Use Type and Use Urgency fill in the form without saving it, and Copy Wording copies the wording. Nothing changes until you save.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Hxfv_59gRT", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When the AI sees a possible risk of harm, Churchit at once assigns the suggestion to the Church Pastoral Care users of the church, with a To Do that says \"Read this prayer request now.\" The prayer team, other staff and the person who asked never see the suggestions or that assignment.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "X4vjkxWJM3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A request gets no suggestion when the person who made it, or its church, keeps out of AI, or when the church has no reviewer in AI Settings (see the Foundations manual).", "col": 12}}, {"id": "-2LuDWoqNy", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The AI never replies to a request, never approves it and never changes its status or visibility. It can miss a risk. Read every request yourself.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "s1rR1nNQjM", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83e\udd32Prayers", "col": 12}}, {"id": "DWu759ud5S", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A Prayer records that someone prayed, and what for. Most Prayers come from members who tap I prayed in the member portal: Churchit makes the Prayer for them, with their note. Church Manager and Church Pastoral Care users can also add a Prayer by hand, for example for a prayer written for a service. Other staff can read Prayers.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "VPhTWn5tgT", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "", "col": 12}}, {"id": "m2lCtTBiqh", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To add a Prayer by hand:", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Vu2FsgAzH5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Open Prayers and click Add Prayer.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "pgVWY5dE1C", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "2. Pick the Person who prayed. With more than one church, the person must belong to your church.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "HsMqBuUOG2", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "3. Type the prayer, or attach a file for a written or recorded prayer.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "WMPV20rvEB", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "4. In Prayer Topics, add a row for each thing that was prayed for. Choose the kind of record first, such as Prayer Request, Person, Function or Missionary, then the record itself. You can choose only a prayer request that you can open.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "hFz7MOD8Sq", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Each Prayer that names a prayer request adds one to that request's prayed count. A Prayer is titled with the name of the person and the day, such as James Wilson, Sunday, November 15, 2026. A person's prayer requests and Prayers show on the Connections tab of their Person form.", "col": 12}}]
